text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick threadraft for the launch post is up: https://docs.google.com/example. Angle = Redwood Optimize walkthrough + short benchmark note + tiny embeddings snippet + inbound routing. Need legal + sales + growth signoff by EOD Tuesday to hit Wed AM publish.

Diego (Content): I'll paste a very small embedding example to include inline for devs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-lite","input":"Why use Redwood Optimize"}'
```

Priya (Growth): CTA strategy suggestion: two primary CTAs + webinar. Add utm params: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=optimize_launch. Also propose a short promo code OPT24 for webinar to track conversion.

Sam (Sales): Routing mapping: "Request a demo" -> HubSpot form HB-DEMO-77 (route AE-enterprise). "Try Hosted API" -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth SDR). Webinar -> Eventbrite webhook -> HubSpot list "Optimize-Webinar-24". Ops note: if registrant.company_size > 50 AND role in ["Eng","ML","Product"], mark MQL and create AE task.

Nina (Legal): Quick legal pass: remove any un-cited numeric claims. Use conservative language: "reduces per-token cost through batching and caching". Replace "guarantee" with "targets". Approve after those edits.

Diego (Content): Done  replaced numeric line and swapped "guarantee" -> "targets". Added promo code and UTMs into CTA links. Tightened hero headline for A/B test: Variant A = "Optimize inference costs and latency"; Variant B = "Lower inference spend without sacrificing latency". Would like to run A/B on hero for first 48 hours.

Ava (Marketing): Good idea on A/B. Priya can wire tracking. OpsBot: can we schedule a 48-hour headline A/B in CMS?

OpsBot: Confirmed. CMS supports A/B hero for 48 hours starting at publish. Publish slot 2024-09-04T09:00Z. Final copy lock 2024-09-03T16:00Z.

Ava (Marketing): Please drop a :thumbsup: when you approve CMS copy.

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS must match doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved. Will DM exact HubSpot field mappings to Ops.

Priya (Growth): :thumbsup: from growth. I'll add UTMs and promo code to sheet and share link in doc.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team  pushing to CMS once Sam's mapping is in. Closing thread.
